rule: weekly cross-section of 14 index CFDs ranked by quote-count activity; long the top third, short the bottom third for one week, equal risk, stop 1R = 3 x ATR(20)

T1.measure: abnormal activity (20-day / 250-day mean quote count), long the highest third

T2.measure: Amihud illiquidity (20-day mean |log return| / quote count), long the highest third
